placements.why: Shipping the async decision widget is the concrete product instantiation of this leaf's core positioning claim — 'every conversation should produce a persistent decision artifact' — directly embodying the anti-Slack thesis rather than merely referencing it.

The shipped widget (src-1) realizes this leaf's insight of capturing decisions at the moment of consensus rather than letting them evaporate into scroll-back; the Zephyr integration (src-3) is named as the specific mechanism enabling that in-thread capture across Slack/Teams/Discord; the record 23-point velocity (src-2) is offered as the execution proof point that the capture mechanism works efficiently — all three cohere as one chain of evidence for the same capture-at-consensus theme rather than standing as three separate facts.
